extDescription.message: 로컬 우선 방식의 암호화된 비밀번호 관리자입니다. 클라우드 데이터베이스가 없습니다.
extDescription.description: Chrome Web Store / extension description shown under the name.

cmdLockVault.description: Keyboard-shortcut command label shown in chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

cmdFillLogin.description: Keyboard-shortcut command label shown in chrome://extensions/shortcuts. Fills the saved login for the page.

notNow.description: Dismiss button on the save / passkey corner prompt.

toggleShow.description: Reveal the captured password in the save-login card.

toggleHide.description: Hide the revealed password in the save-login card.

menuNeverForSite.description: Overflow-menu action: stop offering to save logins on this site.

fieldUsername.description: Field label in the save-login card.

fieldPassword.description: Field label in the save-login card.

fieldAccount.description: Field label showing the account name in the update / passkey card.

saveNewLogin.description: Title of the card offering to save a newly captured login.

actionSave.description: Primary button: save the captured login.

actionUnlockAndSave.description: Primary button when the vault is locked: unlock, then save.

updateExistingTitle.description: Card title when several saved logins could be updated.

updateSavedTitle.description: Card title when one saved login could be updated.

actionUpdate.description: Primary button: update the saved login with the new password.

actionUnlockAndUpdate.description: Primary button when the vault is locked: unlock, then update.

saveAsNew.description: Secondary button: save as a separate login instead of updating.

saveAsNewHint.description: Tooltip for the 'Save as new' button.

passkeySignInWhich.description: Passkey card title when the site offers a choice of passkeys.

passkeyUseTitle.description: Passkey card title when signing in with a single passkey.

passkeyAddToTitle.description: Passkey card title: choose which saved login to attach a new passkey to.

passkeyAddTitle.description: Passkey card title when adding a passkey to an existing login.

passkeySaveTitle.description: Passkey card title when saving a brand-new passkey.

passkeyUnlockUseNote.message: 이 사이트에서 패스키를 사용하려면 Bramble을 잠금 해제하세요.
passkeyUnlockUseNote.description: Explains the locked passkey sign-in prompt.

passkeyUnlockSaveNote.message: 이 사이트에 패스키를 저장하려면 Bramble을 잠금 해제하세요.
passkeyUnlockSaveNote.description: Explains the locked passkey save prompt.

passkeyRequestedBy.description: Label in the passkey card naming the site that asked, when it isn't the page the card is shown on (an embedded frame).

passkeyAddsTo.description: Label showing which login a new passkey will be attached to.

passkeyCreateNewLogin.description: Option to attach the passkey to a brand-new login instead of an existing one.

passkeyUse.description: Primary button: sign in with the passkey.

passkeyAdd.description: Primary button: attach the passkey to a login.

passkeySave.description: Primary button: save the new passkey.

passkeyUnlockUse.description: Primary button when locked: unlock, then sign in with the passkey.

passkeyUnlockAdd.description: Primary button when locked: unlock, then attach the passkey.

vaultLocked.description: Autofill dropdown row shown when the vault is locked.

vaultLockedUnlockHint.description: Sub-text under 'Vault locked' in the autofill dropdown.

newLoginTitle.description: Last row of the autofill dropdown under a site's saved logins. Opens Bramble's form to save another login for this site.

suggestPasswordUse.description: Sub-text under the generated password in the autofill dropdown; the row fills a strong password on signup forms.

suggestPasswordRegenerate.description: Accessible label for the regenerate button on the suggested-password row.

pickerUseKeyboard.message: 이 페이지에서 채우려면 ↓ 키와 Enter 키를 사용하세요.
pickerUseKeyboard.description: Shown in the autofill dropdown when a click was refused because the browser could not confirm the list is fully visible (something on the page covers or filters it). The arrow-key and Enter path still works.

aliasUse.description: Sub-text on the email-alias row in the autofill dropdown; the row creates a fresh forwarding address at the user's alias provider and fills it into a signup form.

aliasTitle.description: Title of the email-alias row in the autofill dropdown.

aliasWorking.description: Shown on the email-alias row while the request to the alias provider is in flight.

aliasFailed.description: Shown on the email-alias row when the alias provider rejected the request. The provider's own explanation is shown beneath as plain text.

aliasRetry.description: Accessible label for the retry button on a failed email-alias row.

cardUsedHere.description: Badge on the autofill dropdown row for the card already filled elsewhere on this page (a hosted-fields checkout asks once per frame).
